The Development

Nirú Las Casitas

Nirú Las Casitas is a newly completed boutique residential development in Santa Cruz, Huatulco — designed for the ideal balance of privacy, resort-style amenities, and authentic coastal living.

The development sits directly adjacent to Santa Cruz Beach, one of Huatulco's most beloved swimming beaches, and is within easy walking distance of the marina, restaurants, banks, and pharmacies.

Construction Notice: Nirú Las Casitas is in the final stages of completion, scheduled for full delivery by end of 2026. Guests may experience daytime construction activity. The second pool will be available from late 2026.
Nirú Beach Club — Adjacent to the Complex
The Nirú Beach Club offers additional beach amenities, food & beverage service, and lounge facilities. Access is not included in condo pricing but available for separate purchase.

Our Story

Francisco &
Mateo Bravo

What begins with a dream of a slower, sun-drenched life in Mexico is, for Francisco and Mateo Bravo, now a reality in the making.

Mateo holds a PhD from the University of Kansas and spent over 20 years in senior healthcare leadership. Francisco brings decades of hospitality experience and has served as their full-time property manager for years.

Francisco and Mateo are currently based in the US and plan to relocate to Mexico full time in the coming years.

How We Manage Your Stay
Mateo and Francisco personally handle all reservations, pricing, pre-arrival communication, and guest support. Upon arrival, you'll be welcomed by our trusted local host in Huatulco who handles in-person check-in, property orientation, and is your on-the-ground contact throughout your stay.

Passion for Mexico

The Destination

Why Huatulco?

Tucked along the Oaxacan coast where the Sierra Madre del Sur meets the Pacific, Huatulco is Mexico's best-kept secret.

🌊
Nine Bays, 36 Beaches
From calm swimming coves to secluded anchorages — most remain blissfully uncrowded.
⛰️
Sierra Madre Meets the Sea
The dramatic backdrop of jungle-draped mountains tumbling to the Pacific creates scenery unlike any other resort town in Mexico.
🐠
World-Class Eco-Tourism
Snorkel, dive, kayak, raft jungle rivers, hike to waterfalls. Huatulco is a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve.
🍽️
Authentic Oaxacan Culture
From the vibrant markets of La Crucecita to fresh seafood right on the sand — this is Mexico as it's meant to be.
✈️
Easily Accessible
Huatulco International Airport (HUX) is just 20 minutes away, with direct flights from Mexico City, Guadalajara, and growing international routes.

La Crucecita & Santa Cruz

Wander lively market stalls for handcrafted jewelry and Oaxacan textiles. Then follow the waterfront to the marina, where fishing boats head out at dawn and return with the day's catch.
